editorialPrinciples: The original audio file is the only master clock.
Prefer deliberate cuts on percussion/transient boundaries discovered by TrackPrompt; do not manufacture constant rapid cutting.
Reuse generated clips with alternate in-points, restrained crops, overlays and occasional reverse motion, but never place the exact same framing back-to-back.
Use dissolves primarily at chapter boundaries; the bridge may use two-frame glitch cuts.
Add titles, artist text and credits only in DaVinci Resolve, never in generated footage.

gradeTarget.workingColorSpace: DaVinci Wide Gamut / Intermediate or project default
gradeTarget.notes: Protect cobalt shadow separation, keep amber highlights rare, unify blacks without crushing wet-glass detail.

finishingOptions: Subtle 35mm grain applied once at timeline level.
Very restrained chromatic separation only at declared glitch cuts.
Optional letterbox added at final timeline level, not burned into generated clips.
Use optical flow only after visual review; generated clips already target 24 FPS.
